title: Resolve named sources and release families
objective: Exact named-source requests distinguish the product family from related catalog text.
outcome: Reviewed names/acronyms and exact product anchors cover the core cohort and twelve expansion families. Not-yet-indexed identities are recorded without inventing catalog membership. MEPS/HCUP/NPPES/PHC4 exact-name fixtures cannot resolve to unrelated descriptions mentioning similar words. Family relations come from source-native links and documented series; the 579 repeated-title cases are accounted for and title equality alone never deletes or merges a record. Named-source matches have their own result state. An unavailable named source returns a specific bounded coverage explanation, not a fabricated exact match. Catalog membership and source-family recognition remain distinct. Sealed packages/identity/src/family-graph.mjs and fingerprint-sealed packages/retrieval/tools/question-parser.mjs are not edited.
